locale.name: package.description
locale.en: Manage and restrict access to REST API endpoints via OAuth authentication.

locale.name: settings.access_lifetime.description
locale.en: Lifetime of an access token in seconds.

locale.name: settings.refresh_token_lifetime.description
locale.en: Lifetime of a refresh token in seconds. Rotation starts a new lifetime for the replacement token.

locale.name: settings.refresh_token_rotation_grace_period.description
locale.en: Period in seconds during which a recently replaced refresh token may return the same token response again. Later reuse revokes the complete token family. 0 disables the grace period.

locale.name: settings.reuse_refresh_tokens_for_dynamic_clients.text
locale.en: Reuse refresh tokens for dynamic clients

locale.name: settings.reuse_refresh_tokens_for_dynamic_clients.description
locale.en: Keeps refresh tokens stable for dynamically registered public clients so multiple running MCP client instances can share the same credentials. Access tokens are still renewed, and explicit revocation invalidates the complete token family. Disable to enforce strict refresh token rotation.

locale.name: settings.dynamic_client_registration.description
locale.en: Allows MCP clients such as Codex to register themselves as public PKCE clients without a client secret. Dynamic clients are permanently bound to a resource on the same origin or a configured VHost domain during their first login.

locale.name: permission.quiqqer.oauth-server.manage_clients
locale.en: Has permission to manage OAuth clients (CRUD)

locale.name: permission.quiqqer.oauth-server.create_permanent_access_token_for_own_user
locale.en: May create a permanent access token for their own user account (OAuth client with client secret and setting "client_secret_is_token").

locale.name: permission.quiqqer.oauth-server.max_number_of_permanent_access_tokens
locale.en: Maximum number of client secrets that are valid as permanent access tokens. (-1 = no limit)

locale.name: profile.tokens.info
locale.en: These tokens work like personal access tokens. Treat them like a password and use them for bearer authentication, for example against the MCP server.

locale.en: Do you really want to delete this API token? Access using this token will stop working afterwards.

locale.name: cron.cleanupAccessTokens.description
locale.en: Deletes all OAuth Access Tokens from the database that have been expired for at least 24h.
